name: QP / A-COM
one_liner: The deterministic authority and truth kernel beneath autonomous work.
core_thesis: Cost of cognition trends toward zero, but permission to change consequential state remains scarce. Therefore cognition, truth and authority must be separated. Untrusted proposals may only alter canonical state after deterministic gates pass, and external consequences require scoped cryptographic grants. Every accepted transition emits a replayable receipt.
why_now: The rest of the portfolio needs exactly this boundary as agents gain more tools and autonomy.
job: Know exactly what can be believed, committed or executed and why.
distribution: Internal kernel first; reusable protocol/runtime later.
moat: Minimal composable semantics plus evidence/grant/receipt history across real autonomous systems.
falsifiers: Existing authorization/attestation standards fully subsume the runtime semantics.
Deterministic gates cannot capture enough useful acceptance conditions.

success_definition: All 12 checkpoints PROVEN on live evidence, with no unresolved critical H-task or security gate.

repo_binding.polling: GitHub snapshots are implementation evidence only; checkpoint proof comes from validator receipts.

software_substitution_test.counterfactual: OpenAI/platform vendors ship perfect software for every reproducible feature in this project tomorrow.
surviving_value: policy state under real delegated authority
software_substitution_test.rationale: The open protocol should be copyable. Strategic value appears only if real systems entrust consequential authority and receipts to it.

underengineer.rule: Choose the earliest real-world event that increases controlled scarce state; build only its prerequisites plus safety and verification.
underengineer.scarce_state_target: Gate exactly one real consequential action
underengineer.minimal_live_product: One action, one grant, one deterministic gate, one credential-brokered execution and one signed transition receipt. Do not expand the instruction set first.

steps.acceptance: Receipt binds pre-state, evidence, program, grant and post-state.

underengineer.graduation_rule: At least one asset campaign refuses or executes a real consequence solely through QP semantics.
underengineer.kill_or_rethink_rule: If live campaigns bypass QP because the authority model is too cumbersome, simplify rather than adding abstractions.
underengineer.project_manager_invariant: A feature may enter NOW only if it is necessary to reach the first real moat event, required for safety/verification, or empirically unblocks that path.
underengineer.observation_pause: After the first live moat event, stop expanding and inspect customer/outcome evidence before choosing the next feature.

full_roadmap_policy: The original checkpoint ladder is a capability library, not default build order. UNDERENGINEER chooses the live minimum path.
